posts.title: Why Discount Rates Only Go Up
posts.description: The annual NACUBO report on tuition discounts was covered in Inside Higher Ed back in April, including a figure showing historical rates. (More recently this was covered in the Economist .) The discount rate is the fraction of posted tuition that is "given back" by the institution in financial aid awards. posts.title: Revisiting A Nation at Risk
posts.description: In 1981 , Reagan's Secretary of Education commissioned a report that became the 1983 A Nation at Risk: the Imperative for Educational Reform . It opens with a jump scare: Our nation is at risk .
